exceptions.rationale: SQLx defaults stay disabled; only Tokio/Rustls, Postgres, migrate, macros, Chrono and JSON are enabled. Cargo still locks rsa 0.9.10 through sqlx-mysql 0.8.6 because the retained sqlx and sqlx-macros-core package metadata declare the optional MySQL driver. Re-verified 2026-10-08: `cargo tree -i rsa --target all -e normal`, `cargo tree -i rsa` and `cargo tree -i rsa --target all -e all --all-features` all print nothing, and `cargo tree -i sqlx-mysql --target all -e all` prints nothing, so rsa has no active path on any target. Removing the derive/migration macro stack would require a broad manual row-decoding and migration-runner rewrite, while RustSec reports no patched rsa release. Do not enable SQLx MySQL/any; remove this exception when SQLx stops locking the unused driver, rsa ships a patch, or the macro stack is deliberately replaced, and re-review immediately if the package becomes reachable. The weekly scheduled advisory scan surfaces the expiry.

braces has no patched release (all versions affected). It is reachable only through @tailwindcss/cli -> @parcel/watcher -> micromatch, which runs for `tailwindcss --watch` on developer machines. The production CSS build and the shipped app never evaluate untrusted glob patterns, so the stack-exhaustion DoS has no attacker-controlled input. Remove when braces ships a fix or Tailwind drops the dependency; re-review if braces becomes reachable from shipped code.
